question: Which of the following countries hosted the 16th G20 Summit in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Italy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **16th**** G20 Summit in October 2021 **was hosted by **Italy in the city of Rome.**
 
• The summit focussed on three broad, interconnected pillars of action: **People, Planet, and Prosperity**.
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi **took part in the summit.
 
• ​​At the summit, the leaders committed to the **key Paris Agreement goal of limiting global warming to 1.5 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **G20 Summit of 2022 and 2023 **will be hosted by **Indonesia and India respectively**.
 
• The G20 is a **strategic multilateral platform connecting the world's major developed and emerging economies **which holds a strategic role in securing future global economic growth and prosperity.
 
• It consists of **19 countries and European Union**.
 
• It was established in **1999 and headquartered in Mexico**.
 
• **Joko Widodo **is the current chairman of the G20.
 
• ** Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Indonesia, Italy, Japan, Republic of Korea, Mexico, Russia, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Turkey, the United Kingdom, the United States, and the European Union **are the members of G20.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ** 2023**
 
• India hosted the 2023 G20 summit, with the theme "One Earth, One Family, One Future". The summit was chaired by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and India's presidency began on December 1, 2022. India's priorities included green development, climate finance, and accelerated growth. 
 
• **2024**
 
• Brazil will host the 2024 G20 summit, with the presidency beginning on December 1, 2023 and ending on November 30, 2024. The summit will be held in Rio de Janeiro.
